_note: The text of the run records in the code panel (TRD addendum 6.3, issues #212, #213 and #214). A run is one press of Run. compare: {a}, {b}, {kept}, {from} and {to} are the plain names of points on the board; {led} is the name of the LED of the level; {on}, {off}, {n}, {line}, {time} and {part} are filled in. The list of changes never names one cause. Write the text in ASD-STE100.
staleHelp: The board or the sketch is different now. Press Run to get a new result.
notSaved: This browser cannot keep your runs. Run works, but there is no history.

compare.title: Compare with last run
compare.one: You have one run. Change a wire or the sketch, and press Run again. Then you can compare the two runs.

observed.blink: {led} blinks: on for {on} ms, off for {off} ms.

compare.changes: What changed between the two runs
compare.same: The two runs have the same board and the same sketch.
compare.moved: Moved: {kept} was connected to {from}. Now it is connected to {to}.
compare.removed: Removed: {a} is not connected to {b} now.
compare.layoutOnly: A wire or a part is in other holes, but the connections are the same.
compare.shown: The board shows {name} now: its holes glow.
compare.onBench: Your board and your sketch are the same as this run.
compare.restored: The board and the sketch of that run are back. Press Run to see the result of this board.
compare.undoHelp: This puts back the board and the sketch from before the restore.
compare.undone: The board and the sketch from before the restore are back. Press Run to see the result.
compare.causes: Each change in this list is a possible cause of a different result. The list does not tell which one. Test your idea: change one thing, then press Run.
compare.unrun: Your board or your sketch has changes that you did not run. This comparison is between the two runs.
